batch.title: Batch test
batch.description: Select several GRE tunnels or several servers. Each target is pinged 10 times, and the report shows the lowest, average and highest ping from those attempts plus the average bandwidth.
batch.previewNote: The preview does not send a real command. Ten ping samples are built from the latest observed latency, and bandwidth is the current average of transmit and receive.
batch.liveNote: Each command goes to the agent on that server and ping runs 10 times. GRE bandwidth uses iperf3 with a 100 Mbps cap, or speedtest on the same interface when no listener is enrolled. Servers are measured with speedtest.net.
batch.limit: Each test can include at most {max} targets.
batch.emptyGre: No GRE tunnel with an interface and an inner IP is registered.
batch.emptyServers: No server is available for the test.
batch.confirmBody: A test command is sent for {count} targets. Each destination is pinged 10 times, then its bandwidth is measured.
batch.line: {name}: max ping = {max} | average {avg} | min: {min} | average bandwidth {mbps}
